Chinese-linked hackers use AI to breach global organizations

Chinese-linked hackers have used artificial intelligence to breach the systems of "hundreds of organizations worldwide," according to Microsoft. The cyberattacks targeted ConnectWise, a company that provides IT services to numerous other organizations. The breach was reported by The Telegraph (India) and Business Standard.
